Name: Bog's Forest UI Interface
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fLsq3z9q/logo.png[/img]

Listen, we are SEVERELY lacking visual mods for the swamp witches, goblins, ghouls and toads. So this is the next step in making a mossy, mushroomy dark wood toned entire recolor/retexture for Stardew Valley!

To Download:
Have Content Patcher already installed
Unzip the file
Drag it into your mods folder
(if you have Generic Mod Config Menu replace the two assets as directed in the folder)
ENJOY!

Check out my other mods!
